source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Select the records containing failed advertised performances.
3. Write down the product model number, serial number, rating and any other pertinent data in the product identification block. Use the advertised specification and any other marketing material.
4. Transfer the data of the failed advertised specifications to the report output form.
5. Modify the summary page as necessary by adding in any other performance or function not included in the output form.
6. Do not include any test work, analyses or calculations not related to the advertised specification.
